## 2. Goal and Scope
### Goal
Describe the product outcome this feature must achieve.

### Non-goals
List what this feature explicitly does not solve.

### Definition of Done
- [ ] DFR updated and approved
- [ ] Code implemented
- [ ] Tests added/updated per matrix
- [ ] Telemetry implemented and verified
- [ ] "What's New" added/updated
- [ ] Rollout plan documented

### MVP / V1 / Nice-to-have
- MVP:
- V1:
- Nice-to-have:
